description: Configure an animated overlay with editable values, look, aspect, duration or background. Returns its configuration URL, free/Pro tier, relevance (field ids the final configuration uses or does not), activeCues (taps this exact configuration has, usable as sfx overlay-cue ids; empty when it has none) and inactiveEdits (requested values kept but unused by this layout, with a notice). Field errors list allowed inputs so you can correct and retry. Changes to free preset text generally need Pro to render.
name: configure_overlay
